intro: Ebru is a night elf druid sheltering in the crags above the Wailing Caverns. As one of Naralex's few remaining uncorrupted disciples, she watches helplessly as her master's dream of restoring the Barrens curdles into a nightmare. From her perch, she enlists travelers brave enough to enter the subterranean depths to cull the mutated horrors spawned by the Nightmare.

p: While most of Naralex's followers succumbed to the emerald corruption creeping through the caverns, Ebru managed to escape the nightmare's grasp. Camped inside the cavernous skull formation overlooking the entrance to the Wailing Caverns, she keeps vigil over the descent. She knows that Naralex's noble plan—to tap subterranean springs and transform the arid Barrens into lush woodland—has gone horribly awry, and she desperately directs willing adventurers to eliminate the burgeoning deviate beasts threatening to overrun the surrounding plains.
